text:
sarah: heads-up — deploy-bot flagged canary for v3.14.0 with p95 ~+40% vs baseline. Auto-rollback didn't trigger (threshold not met). Should we do a manual rollback or pin? :eyes:

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] release v3.14.0 (deploy-2026-03-21-09) canary -> prod. canary p95=420ms (baseline 300ms). Auto-rollback requires >50% regression for 5m; condition not met.

miguel: I can run a manual rollback to v3.13.7. Recommend pinning prod to v3.13.7, pause further promotions, and notify Dedicated customers. Change window ~10m. Any objections? :arrow_right_hook:

anya: +1. I'll draft the rollback blurb and customer advisory for EU Dedicated customers. Suggest we call out: "latency regression on long-context requests" in the note?

tom: Can we do a regional rollback (us-west) only? Metrics show the spike concentrated in us-west canary pool, would be less disruptive than global revert.

miguel: Regional slice is possible but messy mid-change-window and risks config drift. Simpler to pin globally now and do a staged re-release if needed. Exec plan: 1) pin version 2) invoke rollback 3) monitor p95 / error rate 4) notify stakeholders. Commands: ```sh
# pin prod to prior version
deployctl pin-version --env prod --version v3.13.7 --reason "canary p95 regression"
# trigger rollback job
deployctl rollback --deploy-id=deploy-2026-03-21-09 --target-version=v3.13.7
```

sarah: :thumbsup: Miguel — include monitor links and who owns postmortem. I'll take postmortem.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued -> job-77821. Notifying on-call.

anya: Draft customer note: "We have reverted today's release due to a latency regression affecting long-context generation. No data loss. We're investigating root cause and will follow up with a timeline." Thoughts?

tom: If the rollback job stalls, escalate to eng-oncall and run fallback: `kubectl rollout undo` for the affected deployment. Also loop in @support to notify Dedicated customers via their CSMs.

miguel: Starting rollback now. I'll post status. Owners: sarah -> postmortem, anya -> comms, miguel -> exec.

sarah: Quick checklist: - pin done? - rollback started? - monitors up (p95 trending down)? Link: https://grafana.redwood/d/xyz - cust comm sent to Dedicated list? anya pls confirm.

anya: Sent to dedicated-cust@redwood.com and CSMs. Subject: "Prod rollback - v3.14.0 reverted".

deploy-bot: rollback job job-77821 SUCCESS. prod now on v3.13.7. p95=310ms. job logs: https://deploy.logs/redwood/job-77821

tom: Nice. Follow-ups (postmortem/action items): (1) tighten auto-rollback thresholds, (2) add per-region heuristics to deploybot, (3) test traffic-slicing runbook, (4) verify canary load profile for long-context.

sarah: Adding to release retro + postmortem doc. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
